I checked and I was charged for the box.  I called customer service twice and was told that my cancellation date missed the cutoff date for the box. TLDR; Activation of account resulted in automatic charge.  Don’t download the app to browse boxes like I did.

reviews.title: Too hot for shipping
reviews.text:
Shipping food during a heatwave, especially with additional heat warnings in effect, feels far too risky for me. I recently experienced food poisoning from spoiled beef—not HelloFresh. To be absolutely clear, I did not become sick from HelloFresh. However, I did discard the raw chicken included in this box because I was not comfortable taking any chances with food safety.

As a result, I’m particularly cautious about perishable food being exposed to extreme temperatures during shipping. I was not comfortable with this box being shipped from Texas and potentially sitting inside a hot delivery truck for most of the day before arriving at my home in the late afternoon. Given the extreme temperatures, I simply do not feel confident that the food was maintained at a safe temperature throughout the delivery.

Ultimately, this was a $29.00 mistake on my part, but given my recent experience with food poisoning, I believe being cautious about the safety of perishable food is completely justified.

reviews.title: 1 star – Extremely disappointing customer service
reviews.text:
I’ve been on and off with HelloFresh for years, but after this experience I absolutely will not be returning.

I cancelled my subscription 4 days before going on holiday, but apparently HelloFresh requires 5 days’ notice. I called them 2 days before the delivery to explain that I was away and had cancelled, but because I had apparently missed the cut-off by just a few hours, they refused to stop the box.

£70 was taken from my account for a box I hadn’t chosen or wanted. I was hoping HelloFresh would show a bit of goodwill given the circumstances, but instead I had to contact them to try to resolve it. I was offered goodwill gestures totalling £34, but I have not received that refund yet. This still leaves me paying for a box that I had tried to cancel before it was delivered.

My friend was looking after my dog while I was away and received the box. When she opened it, it was missing fish, meat, tomatoes, onions and peppers. She contacted HelloFresh again and was offered compensation for the missing ingredients, but I have not received that refund yet either.

What makes the whole situation even more frustrating is that because I had cancelled, I hadn’t selected the recipes. HelloFresh simply sent whatever meals they decided to send, and not one of them was something that I, my family or even my friend would have chosen or wanted to eat.

If you’re going to send a box that the customer hasn’t selected, you’d think you might at least send some of your more popular meals. Inst

reviews.title: Beware of Overcharging
reviews.text: I was a customer for a while and then cancelled to save money. They sent me a discount code in the mail so I signed back up with that code and selected my meals. I was excited to sign back up, selected more meals than usual (we usually do three or four, I picked out five because the discount was over 50% on the first box). I confirmed my order and even picked out the next few weeks of meals. Then a few days passed and I checked my bank statement. I was charged almost double the amount I had seen on the app when I confirmed my order. Instead of 50%+ the discount was something like 10%. My order had been less than $100 altogether with the discount, the charges on my bank statement were almost $160. I contacted HelloFresh thinking it was a mistake and we’d just resolve it and move on. Wrong. I’ve been a customer for almost a year, received ten boxes or so, and when I reached out about the charges the agent said because it was past the cutoff to cancel the box, there was nothing they could do about the charges. They said they understood my frustration but the box was already being packed and no refunds were possible, even though the agent acknowledged that I was sent a specific discount in the mail, applied it, and then was charged with a different, much smaller discount. In the end I said ok I guess I’ll just cancel, I’m really disappointed that I was charged an amount I didn’t agree to and that there is nothing you can do and the agent said ok, I can help you with that cancella

reviews.title: Poor Customer service.
reviews.text:
I was excited to try HelloFresh, but unfortunately my experience has been disappointing.

After deciding I no longer wanted to receive another box, I was surprised to find that I was still being charged and sent one. I reached out to customer service hoping to better understand what happened and see if there was anything they could do. I was polite throughout the conversation, but the representative I spoke with was not very understanding or helpful, which made an already frustrating situation even more disappointing.

I was also underwhelmed by the meal selection. While the meals are good, I found that many of the options become repetitive from week to week. If you want more variety or the more appealing meals, you often have to pay an additional charge on top of the subscription price. That makes it difficult to feel like you’re getting good value.

Overall, I expected better customer service and more flexibility with both the ordering process and the meal options. I hope HelloFresh takes customer feedback seriously and works to improve both the customer experience and the variety offered in their meal plans.

I am honestly shocked to see a company that seems to promote such good motives, work so poorly at customer satisfaction. The representative I worked with had also made a point to tell me to “donate the food to a local food bank” if I didn’t wish to receive it. Which would be a great idea except the box “ I didn’t prefer to receive” cost what little money I had for foo

reviews.title: Takes money without asking

reviews.title: Zero reliability and appalling customer service – Left with no food at 9pm!
reviews.text: I ordered from HelloFresh for the very first time last week, selecting a 5-meal box to feed my family for the upcoming week. The box was scheduled for delivery today (Monday). By 9pm, nothing had arrived.I was never sent a notification or warning about a delay. It was only because I proactively initiated a live chat with support that I was finally told my box was not going to be delivered at all.Instead of immediately offering a refund for this massive failure, the agent repeatedly tried to pressure me into waiting until tomorrow so they could "find a solution". I had to firmly demand my money back twice before they finally agreed to process a refund.To make matters worse, HelloFresh has sent zero official email confirmation regarding my refund. Once the chat window closed, my only proof of their agreement vanished. I am now left at 9pm on a Monday night with a hungry family, no groceries, no proof of my refund, and forced to spend extra money on last-minute food. Absolutely terrible first experience. Avoid this company if you actually need your food to arrive.

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text:
The staff member who came to my home told me he was there to help me set up the HelloFresh app. I specifically informed him that I was not ready to place an order at that time. He assured me that he was only setting up the app and not making any purchases.
However, money was later taken from my account. When I questioned this, I was told that the funds would be returned. Instead, I was notified that I was due to receive a grocery delivery.
I then contacted the HelloFresh customer support team to cancel the order. I was assured that the cancellation would be processed, yet money was still withdrawn from my bank account.
I am extremely disappointed with this experience and feel misled by the entire process. As a first-time customer, this has left me with a very negative impression of the service. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend HelloFresh to others and hope the company takes steps to improve its customer service and sales practices.

reviews.title: Worst app delivery food ever

reviews.title: App Turned To Garbage
reviews.text: Long time Hello Fresh customer, so well accustomed to the fun and games of missing ingredients (have they ever had a pomegranate?) and/or the smallest sweet potatoes you’ve ever seen. So far, so normal. However, over the past few months, the app has become a total disaster. Picking a few weekly meals has become an ordeal, so much so that I’ve had to ditched the phone and move over to a computer and the website. Menus won’t scroll, or will crash and reload if you try to love beyond the first few meals. And that’s if it’ll let you log in. The most common issue is that I’ve been logged out, and my credentials are refused. These same credentials are then accepted on the website. You don’t expect to find yourself struggling with app crashes, in the same way I didn’t expect to be shopping for the peas you didn’t pack in my recipe kit. Or the limes the week before. Or the avocado.. etc… etc…

reviews.title: DONT DO IT You will forget to cancel and will pay more! Pay a nutritionist to meal plan for you!!
reviews.text: They make money taking advantage of the fact you might forget to skip a week. It’s not easy, you can’t just ‘turn it off for the foreseeable future’. As a uni student, I probably ‘accidentally’ had to have a £40 delivery 4 times. Oh and don’t get me started on ANY company that has a 2 step account deletion process where you have to remember your email, password and request deletion is 100% profiting off of making services complicated. Regardless of the concept being good, you’re better off paying a nutritionist that £30 a week to hand pick you a meal plan within your budget AND factor in who you are.

reviews.title: Duped! Won’t refund or cancel.
reviews.text:
I saw the Hello Fresh 50% offer, was looking to save money, and refresh my eating habits. When signing up you submit a payment of £1 which is promptly refunded. Once into the App and viewed some of the meals available, I decided that Hello Fresh wasn’t for me. So left the app. 
Thirty minutes  later I received a bank notification of a charge made by Hello Fresh for my first order.
I contacted Hello Fresh and expressed my desire to cancel not just this week, but the next four also that were preselected for me by Hello Fresh. I was told that I would not be able to cancel this weeks and that the delivery and charges will still apply, despite my registration being less than 2 hours old. 
I merely enquired, and was charged without completing the order myself, it was completed automatically by Hello Fresh. Really disappointing that there are still companies out there who entice you in, charge people, and then refuse to refund. I just want to make others before they sign up and are charged also.

reviews.title: disrespectful and low quality
reviews.text: each meal costs about four times as much as just buying the ingredients yourself. i understand that i pay for convenience, but this price is too high. i remember first hearing of hello fresh and it being advertised as a way to save money, and it was. it also used to come with much more recyclable packaging, in my last box the only thing i could put in the recycling bin was the box itself, which was about three times larger than it needed to be, and the three paper bags that some of the ingredients came in, which were also largely oversized. the company model has now turned into a hope that the customer is too late to cancel a box to charge them for just one more. i ordered my last box a day and a half before its arrival and it didn’t seem to be an issue, but all other boxes get paid for five days in advance with no way to cancel? suspicious. i also cancelled my subscription and requested the deletion of my account, and the response was that they’re not going to delete my account because they’re not actually legally required to do so. gross. the app is also very low quality and constantly glitches, once having told me that a box had been cancelled and then i got charged anyway with no way for a refund

reviews.title: Never going back
reviews.text: We’ve been hello fresh customers on and off for 7 years. Recently we’ve had a plan to get four meals a week, for 3 people, for $142. Fast forward to today, when a giant box arrived, with 8 meals, and a $250 charge to our account. We thought, easy fix, we’ll call and tell them they sent us double the food and charged us double the price, assuming we would get a refund for whatever error occurred. Instead the customer service agent attempted to gaslight us into saying we had ordered 7 meals. Who orders 7 HelloFresh meals?? We’re feeding two adults and a 7yo. What am I going to do with 9 packages of meat that have to be cooked in 5 days- because the packaging conveniently says you can’t freeze the meat... We offered to send the food back because it says on the package it is only good for 5 days- no, they’re keeping our money and there’s nothing they can do about it. The customer service agent said, “we have it in our system that you ordered 7 meals”. We did not order 7, and we were delivered 8! Clearly their system was wrong… The agent then asked for a screenshot of our HelloFresh account showing we only get four meals. She then said “oh… I can see you only get four meals…”. Long story short, my refrigerator is full of food I won’t have time to cook, my account is $250 less, and HelloFresh can kiss my butthole for having the worst customer service I’ve ever experienced.
